profile.headline: Software Engineer at Bloomberg LP
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: I am a software engineer currently working for Bloomberg LP. Technology is one of my passions, and I am always looking for ways to use it to help me grow in both a professional light as well as in my personal life. I am an infrastructure engineer with experience in JavaScript runtimes and developer tools. I enjoy building/improving things that make other engineers around me more productive such as elegant command line tools, performant runtime environments, and scaled load balancing applications. Main languages of focus are Type/JavaScript and C++. Always open and eager to learning more.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Infrastructure engineer focusing on javascript runtimes and developer tooling.
- TypeScript/JavaScript/C++
- Build out functionality on an internal javascript runtime (C++)
- Backend infrastructure (C++/JavaScript)
- Develop command line tools for other engineers within the company (Node/TypeScript)

positions.title: Solution Developer
positions.description: Develops custom solutions for federal, state, and private clients of Deloitte. Main focus on enterprise application development with a strong focus in Java and SQL.

positions.title: Summer Engineer
positions.description: Summer engineer intern with Deloitte. Work on consulting projects at the US delivery center for Deloitte. Provide software/technology solutions for both federal and private clients. Primary focus in Java/Database technologies.

positions.title: Support Analyst Intern
positions.description: Contracted through Superior Group LLC. Test and maintain Oracle Fusion rollout for payroll systems of Siemens' North America employee base.

volunteerExperiences.description: Helped time a swim meet for the YMCA

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Habitat for Humanity of Greater Orlando Area
volunteerExperiences.description: Helped build a "shack" with the UCF swim club and won money to help Habitat for Humanity.
